48/G.goal: Explain how an interactive XR system can be implemented under either a traditional stage-based lifecycle or an agile sprint-based lifecycle and how that affects delivery.
48/G.achieves: This equips the learner with the development-process foundation needed to build the course's XR case study and prepare for subsequent optimization.

48/O1.goal: Describe how implementation in an interactive system can be managed through a traditional stage-based lifecycle or an agile sprint-based lifecycle and what that means for delivery.
48/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for understanding implementation trade-offs when building the XR case study and preparing for later optimization.
